methodCatalog.applicability: 想联系但不知道聊什么、何时继续，或有多个可行方向。

methodCatalog.applicability: 用户明确要草稿、改写，或采用已讨论且明确可分享的内容。

methodCatalog.name: 找回与回顾
methodCatalog.applicability: 问以前说过什么、约定进展，或希望回顾一段时间的互动。

methodCatalog.name: 考虑一起做点什么
methodCatalog.applicability: 用户想邀约、讨论共同兴趣或寻找文字聊天之外的共同活动。

methodCatalog.name: 纠正理解与用法
methodCatalog.applicability: 用户纠正事实、分享范围、目标、建议风格，或要求记住/更改/忘记。

methodCatalog.name: 表达好感与关系意图
methodCatalog.applicability: 用户想表达喜欢、明确邀请含义，或希望讨论怎样从友好交流走向恋爱认识。

payload.evidenceRule: historicalOnly=true 的消息仅为历史提及，后续可能有未读的更改，不可据此断言当前约定有效。possiblyStale 的状态只作需要核查的上次理解，新原话与用户纠正优先。

memoryDiscovery.rule: 目录用于发现可核对的旧事、自述和共同背景；先核对原文、后续变化和已表达内容，不能把预览当当前事实、未聊过证明或分享授权。

relationshipContext.activityEvidenceRule: Historical evidence gaps do not negate a separately supported current-state report. Preserve currentReportedState source/asOf/authority; it is not an event occurrence clock. evidenceLosses use a separate loss: namespace, never source handles, citations, sharing permission or new event evidence. They describe prior derived understanding, not current facts: only a statement dependency identifies what the unavailable original previously served as evidence for; definition/time/support loss does not establish the original message meaning. Original author and prior event actor are distinct; a native recall does not identify its operator. Missing/omitted loss details stay unknown. Historical gaps do not negate separately supported newer world or current-state reports.

constraints: 仅为局部经验；不是她的心理或方法因果效果证据。
候选适用性尚未确定，核对applicability与当前任务后再使用；本轮明确意思优先，不相关或相反的指导不采用。
